newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures finish sharply lower, near lows.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures finish sharply lower, near lows.

text.p: U.S. debt futures ended with hefty losses and near day's lows in a drop many traders called technical, as longs used strong economic data to bail out of an overextended market.
Futures built losses again into the close, with September Treasury bonds briefly registering an intraday loss of more than two full points. It settled down 1-30/32 at 114-26/32.

After holding above the week's low, the contract finally punctured 114-28/32, hit sellstops and slumped to key support near 114-23/32, its lowest price since July 22 when it set a daily low at 114-04/32.
Some technicians said several technical supports were scattered across the 114-24/32 to 114-20/32 area.
"Everybody thought there were stops below 28 (114-28/32) said a floor broker. "But then it bounced back up...114-25/32 and 114-14 were key support."
Some noted that Friday's two-point drop, however, erased only a third the contract's six-point gain scored since the end of June and left it in a position to easily return higher.
"I think that they are going back up," added the floor broker. "I think we're going back over 117."
"It's just a liquidation trade," said another broker.
